description_en: Copies a specified production studio and returns the new production studio instance
description_zh: 复制导播台，复制指定导播台并返回新导播台实例
kebab_example: aliyun live copy-caster --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --caster-name caster001 --src-caster-id 'a2b8e671-2fe5-4642-a2ec-bf93880e****' --client-token '53200b81-b761-4c10-842a-a0726d97****' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CopyCaster

parameters.help_en: The name of the new production studio
parameters.name: caster_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the source production studio.

If you created the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, check the value of the CasterId parameter returned in the response.

If you created the production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, choose ApsaraVideo Live console > Production Studios > Cloud Production Studios to view the production studio name.

The production studio name in the production studio list on the Cloud Production Studios page of the ApsaraVideo Live console is the production studio ID
parameters.help_zh:
原导播台ID。

如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台路径查看导播台名称。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: src_caster_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value is generated by the client and must be unique among different requests. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token
